meta.transactions_export_window: transaction date >= 2026-06-01 00:00 store time up to export moment

conventions.signs: discounts and returns are negative; net_sales = gross_sales + discounts + returns; total_sales = net_sales + shipping + duties + additional_fees + taxes
conventions.returns: Shopify renamed Returns to 'Sales reversals' in 2026. Here returns = reversed item value NET of its discount share (discount not reversed separately) + refunds without items. The alternative convention is in breakdown.returns_alt_convention.
conventions.dates: sale on order/edit/exchange date, reversal on refund/cancel/edit date, all in store time
conventions.currency: USD at each order's own exchange rate, every component converted separately
conventions.gift_cards: gift card sales excluded from gross sales; redemptions are normal sales
conventions.chargebacks: do not affect sales; only money
conventions.cogs: cost per item recorded at sale time; reversals back out cost at reversal date; items without cost are in net_sales_without_cost_recorded

orders.definition: orders created in the month (store time), excluding test and deleted orders; cancelled, unpaid and gift-card-only orders are counted

money_in_transit.definition: Net of all Shopify Payments balance transactions dated up to month end (store time) whose payout had not been deposited by month end, incl. failed payouts awaiting retry; reserve held reported separately.
